result.summary: 本文介绍了 DeepSeek-V3，一个总参数 671B、每 token 激活 37B 的 MoE 语言模型，采用 MLA 与 DeepSeekMoE 架构，并引入无辅助损失的负载均衡策略和多 token 预测训练目标 [abstract][S1.p2]。模型在 14.8T token 上预训练，随后进行 SFT 和 RL 后训练，完整训练仅需 2.788M H800 GPU 小时 [abstract][S1.p6]。综合评估显示其性能超过其他开源模型，并与领先闭源模型相当 [abstract][S1.p5]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在进一步推动开源模型能力边界，通过扩大模型规模并引入 DeepSeek-V3 来缩小与闭源模型的差距 [S1.p1]。同时，研究追求强模型性能与经济成本的平衡，探索在高效训练和推理下保持模型性能 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: To further push the boundaries of open-source model capabilities, we scale up our models and introduce DeepSeek-V3, a large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 671B parameters, of which 37B are activated for each token.
With a forward-looking perspective, we consistently strive for strong model performance and economical costs.

method.text: DeepSeek-V3 采用 MLA 实现高效推理、DeepSeekMoE 实现经济训练，并首创无辅助损失的负载均衡策略以最小化负载均衡对模型性能的不利影响 [S1.p2]。同时设置多 token 预测训练目标以增强评估基准上的整体性能 [S1.p2]。训练支持 FP8 混合精度，并设计 DualPipe 算法实现高效流水线并行，通过计算-通信重叠隐藏大部分通信 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: DeepSeek-V3 still adopts Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) for efficient inference and DeepSeekMoE for cost-effective training.
DeepSeek-V3 pioneers an auxiliary-loss-free strategy for load balancing, with the aim of minimizing the adverse impact on model performance that arises from the effort to encourage load balancing.
DeepSeek-V3 employs a multi-token prediction training objective, which we have observed to enhance the overall performance on evaluation benchmarks.
we introduce an FP8 mixed precision training framework and, for the first time, validate its effectiveness on an extremely large-scale model.
we design the DualPipe algorithm for efficient pipeline parallelism, which has fewer pipeline bubbles and hides most of the communication during training through computation-communication overlap.

experiments.text: 预训练使用 14.8T 高质量多样化 token，最大序列长度 4K，随后通过两阶段上下文扩展至 32K 和 128K [S1.p4][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。后训练包括 SFT 和 RL，SFT 数据集包含 1.5M 实例，RL 采用 GRPO [S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS2.p1]。评估覆盖多学科选择题、语言理解、数学、代码等基准，并与 DeepSeek-V2-Base、Qwen2.5 72B Base、LLaMA-3.1 405B Base 等开源模型比较 [S4.SS4.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: During pre-training, we train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T high-quality and diverse tokens.
We set the maximum sequence length to 4K during pre-training, and pre-train DeepSeek-V3 on 14.8T tokens.
In the first stage, the maximum context length is extended to 32K, and in the second stage, it is further extended to 128K.
We curate our instruction-tuning datasets to include 1.5M instances spanning multiple domains, with each domain employing distinct data creation methods tailored to its specific requirements.

Similar to DeepSeek-V2, we adopt Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which foregoes the critic model that is typically with the same size as the policy model, and estimates the baseline from group scores instead.
we compare the base model of DeepSeek-V3 with the state-of-the-art open-source base models, including DeepSeek-V2-Base (our previous release), Qwen2.5 72B Base, and LLaMA-3.1 405B Base.

findings.text: 综合评估显示 DeepSeek-V3 优于其他开源模型，性能与领先闭源模型相当 [abstract]。基础模型在多数基准上表现最佳，尤其在数学和代码任务上 [S4.T3]。聊天版本在标准与开放式基准上超过其他开源模型，并与 GPT-4o 和 Claude-3.5-Sonnet 相当 [S1.p5]。训练过程稳定，未出现不可恢复的损失尖峰或回滚 [abstract]。

evidence.quote: Comprehensive evaluations reveal that DeepSeek-V3 outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models.
DeepSeek-V3-Base achieves the best performance on most benchmarks, especially on math and code tasks.

Its chat version also outperforms other open-source models and achieves performance comparable to leading closed-source models, including GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet, on a series of standard and open-ended benchmarks.
Throughout the entire training process, we did not experience any irrecoverable loss spikes or perform any rollbacks.

limitations.text: 作者承认 DeepSeek-V3 在部署方面存在局限：推荐部署单元相对较大，可能给小团队带来负担 [S6.p2]。此外，尽管端到端生成速度已超过 DeepSeek-V2 两倍，仍有进一步提升空间 [S6.p2]。这些局限有望随更先进硬件的发展自然解决 [S6.p2]。

evidence.quote: the recommended deployment unit for DeepSeek-V3 is relatively large, which might pose a burden for small-sized teams.
although our deployment strategy for DeepSeek-V3 has achieved an end-to-end generation speed of more than two times that of DeepSeek-V2, there still remains potential for further enhancement.
these limitations are expected to be naturally addressed with the development of more advanced hardware.
